QorCap v0.3.27: highlight clips say SCOREBUG LOCK

Highlight clips now burn **SCOREBUG LOCK** instead of **LOCKED SCORE**.

The panel is a scorebug read committed into the checkpoint chain. **LOCKED SCORE** and **VERIFIED** are reserved for a referee-verified receipt, which is not known when the clip is cut. QorTime match 125430 is FAIL because the capture key is local self-attested, so its clips use the weaker title. The `.vtt` sidecar uses the same words. Panel layout, fonts, cut windows, and the recorder are unchanged.
